description.value: Combine Cafe & Bar is an all-day cafe and bar located in the lobby of Locale at Century City in downtown Surrey, a short walk from King George SkyTrain Station. It offers quality coffee, farm-driven food made with locally sourced ingredients, and a full drinks program including wine, cocktails, and beer. The menu runs from early-morning breakfast and pastries through lunch to evening service, making it a versatile stop for cyclists passing through the area.
